identity.operation: xmlXIncludeProcessNode expands xi:include and calls xmlXIncludeNewRef.
identity.condition: An injected allocation failure occurs at xmlXIncludeNewRef's xmlMalloc.
identity.capability: xmlXIncludeGetLastError must expose XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY to xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure.
identity.consequence: The failure flag is set while ctxt->errNo remains zero, so xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure aborts.

requirement: For an injected XInclude allocation failure, the existing xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure call must see XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY from xmlXIncludeGetLastError.

assessment.requirement: For the frozen candidate o-104532525526df0a, an injected allocation failure at xmlXIncludeNewRef's xmlMalloc must make the existing xmlFuzzCheckMallocFailure expectation true through xmlXIncludeGetLastError.
assessment.target_route: A framed main XML entity contains a well formed xi:include with a nonlocal href. The old entry parses it, resets the allocation failure flag, creates an XInclude context, and calls xmlXIncludeProcessNode. Root processing recognizes the include, expands it, and calls xmlXIncludeNewRef.
assessment.failure_condition: A finite input can select the allocation index of xmlXIncludeNewRef's xmlMalloc within maxAlloc's modulus. The injected allocator returns NULL and sets fuzzAllocFailed. xmlXIncludeErrMemory reports XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY globally but does not set ctxt->errNo. xmlXIncludeGetLastError returns that unchanged context value, so the existing check aborts.
assessment.alternative_paths: The complete old entry has one XInclude context and one XInclude allocation failure check. The valid document avoids the null document and null context branches. xmlXIncludeNewRef returns immediately on the selected failure; xmlXIncludeExpandNode then returns without loading a resource or fallback. No later XInclude error on this route sets ctxt->errNo before the check.
